a.text: A two-year plan (1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027) for customer research at the Company's retail fuel stations.

b.text: Purpose: to understand how customers see the Company's brand. Expected outcome: To improve brand image and general customer awareness.

c.text: One initiative: surveys and focus groups on brand perception, loyalty programme preferences and purchase behaviour at retail stations. Objective: understand customer opinion.

d.text: Research scope: basic. Customer surveys and focus groups.

e.text: Planned expenditure over the plan period is ₦17.5 million, shown by year in the table below.

f.text: Customer surveys and focus groups run by a marketing agency, analysed in spreadsheet software, using standard marketing research methods.

g.text: Retail stations in Lagos, Port Harcourt, Benin City and Warri.

h.text: Estimated duration of the research: 24 months (1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027).

i.text: Sponsoring institution: Sample Brand Research Agency Ltd (fictional). Director: Mr. Kunle Ade-Sample. Officer in charge: Ms. Tola Bakare-Sample.

k.text: The Company does not expect Board participation in the project.

m.text: The Retail Marketing Manager (Mr. Dele Ogunbanjo-Sample) oversees the study, supported by two retail officers.

n.text: Methodology and requirements: questionnaire design, field interviews, focus groups and reporting.

p.text: Year 1 (2026): survey design and fieldwork. Year 2 (2027): analysis and reporting.

expected_outcome_text: To improve brand image and general customer awareness.

project.title: A Comparative Study of Customer Brand Perception, Loyalty Programme Preferences and Purchase Behaviour at Retail Fuel Stations Operated by the Company across Southern Nigerian Urban Markets
project.goals_and_objectives: Survey customers at stations in four cities, run focus groups on loyalty programmes and compare results across cities. The study will help the Company understand its customers better.

kpis.indicator: At least 1,200 completed questionnaires by 31 December 2026
